sloka: वचनं प्राह धर्मज्ञः श्रूयतामिति सत्तमः ।दक्षिणस्योदधेस्तीरे त्रिकूटो नाम पर्वतः ।। ७.३.२५ ॥
transliteration: vacanaṁ prāha dharmajñaḥ śrūyatāmiti sattamaḥ ।dakṣiṇasyodadhestīre trikūṭo nāma parvataḥ ।। 7.3.25 ॥

translations.english: The righteous and excellent one spoke, saying, "Listen! On the shore of the southern ocean, there is a mountain named Trikuta."
